reviewNotes: Held back: the bar lines are read off the rhythm (CCEH's Noteworthy score could not be read); check the pickup against the score. Imported from CCEH tune 000591 (the melody read from 000591a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Francois Hippolytus Barthelemon has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1785, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105).
